decision: Deliver the Choros Postgres substrate: (a) one postgres:16 service in repo-root docker-compose.yml with all conn params via env carrying dev-only defaults (no committed prod secret, RL-1) + healthcheck for unattended bring-up; (b) a zero-dep Node migration runner (migrations/run.mjs, node:* + pg only) applying migrations/NNN_<name>.sql in lexicographic order each in its own transaction, recording every applied file in schema_migrations(version text PK, applied_at timestamptz), skipping already-recorded versions (idempotency), aborting non-zero with no partial bookkeeping, connecting via DATABASE_URL as choros_migrator; (c) baseline choros_* schema as 9 ordered migrations 001-009 materializing ONLY the ratified object model (job, application, registry_def, record, audit_event, audit_head, grant, object_handle) with the full T-0013 tenant-table convention from migration #1 + T-0016 append-only triggers; (d) two roles - choros_app (NOSUPERUSER, NOBYPASSRLS, non-owner, per-table DML, audit_event SELECT/INSERT only, no DDL) + choros_migrator (owner, DDL, never runtime) - provisioned in migration 001; (e) ACT_* readiness as a dedicated choros schema boundary leaving ACT_* namespace free for a future Flowable on the same instance (Flowable NOT installed); (f) integration-honest CI db job standing up a pinned postgres:16 service, running the runner, re-running for idempotency, then a >=2-tenant seed+assert suite plus live RLS/role/FK probes; pg added to package.json exactly once. Proportional: plain SQL + ~120-line Node, no migration framework (Liquibase is Flowable's for ACT_* only). KEY RESOLUTIONS: baseline tables live in a dedicated choros schema (not public) - so all live probes parametrize on nspname='choros', superseding the upstream ADRs' illustrative 'public' (probe detail, not isolation-model change); grant.role_id is a plain uuid NOT NULL column WITHOUT a cross-table FK (the FK to role is deferred to T-0022's migration, since role/assignment are undesigned - confirmed as intended deferral, not omission); the job table DDL is fully owned by T-0053's baseline (T-0114 adds only store code + additive 010_+ migrations, never re-creates job).

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Heavyweight runtime/CLI dep + second migration dialect; violates NF-1 (pg is the only added dep) and zero-dep core discipline. Liquibase is reserved for Flowable's ACT_*; a framework buys nothing the schema_migrations-skip contract doesn't give for a linear append-only catalog.

rejected_alternatives.option: All tables in public schema (matching upstream ADRs' illustrative probes)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: public is where Flowable's Liquibase defaults objects; sharing invites ACT_*/choros_* collision and muddies choros_app's grant surface. A dedicated choros schema is the clean ACT_*-readiness boundary; 'public' in upstream probes was illustrative, re-targeting to 'choros' is a probe detail.

T-0016 supersedes the audit_log placeholder: exactly one audit family (audit_event+audit_head). Creating audit_log too = a second append-only/chain/isolation code-path, the drift T-0016 forbids. audit_log is never created, absent from known_tenant_tables.

rejected_alternatives.option: Add grant.role_id->role FK in baseline, or omit role_id
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Adding the FK fails to apply (no role table -> breaks AC-2/AC-14); omitting the column breaks T-0018's ratified contract (resolver T-0021 reads role_id). Correct: keep role_id uuid NOT NULL as a plain column, defer the FK to T-0022's migration (additive, CI-visible).

rejected_alternatives.option: Provision roles via compose entrypoint script / POSTGRES_INITDB only
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Role existence becomes image-bootstrap state, invisible to migration history and un-rerunnable against an already-initialized DB (e.g. managed prod Postgres). Provisioning roles in migration 001 (idempotent) makes the role layout part of the same ordered skip-applied CI-replayed history - one bring-up path (NF-4), portable.

rejected_alternatives.option: Runner applies all files in one big transaction
rejected_alternatives.why_not: A single failure rolls back all prior files; a long catalog can't advance file-by-file; some DDL can't run in a transaction. Per-file transaction (file SQL + bookkeeping row in the same BEGIN..COMMIT) gives atomic per-file apply + accurate schema_migrations (FR-2).

rejected_alternatives.option: Idempotency via CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS in every migration (no schema_migrations)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Loses applied-history record, can't detect a changed file, doesn't generalize to data seeds/ALTER. Frozen seam mandates schema_migrations-skip; idempotency = already-recorded versions skipped, robust regardless of statement idempotency.

rejected_alternatives.option: Install Flowable / create ACT_* tables now to prove readiness
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Out of scope (E0.5, founder-gated S-1). FR-6 readiness = free ACT_* namespace + schema boundary, not standing up the engine. AC-16 asserts zero ACT_* tables after T-0053.

rejected_alternatives.option: Commit prod credentials / .env with real secrets
rejected_alternatives.why_not: RL-1/NF-5: only non-prod defaults in the repo; prod creds founder-held, injected at deploy (E0.7). Compose reads ${VAR:-dev_default} env; no real secret committed.

contracts: migrations/run.mjs: zero-dep runner (node:* + pg only); ensure choros schema + schema_migrations exist; SELECT applied versions; list+lexicographically-sort migrations/NNN_*.sql; for each unapplied file BEGIN; run SQL; INSERT version (same txn); COMMIT; on error ROLLBACK that file + exit(1) (no partial bookkeeping); skip applied files; exit 0 when done. version key = filename stem so T-0114 010_* appends additively.
docker-compose.yml: postgres:16 service; POSTGRES_DB/USER/PASSWORD/PORT via env with dev defaults (${VAR:-dev_default}); pg_isready healthcheck; named volume; NO committed prod secret.

migration 001 (idempotent DO-blocks): CREATE SCHEMA choros AUTHORIZATION choros_migrator; CREATE ROLE choros_app LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA choros TO choros_app (USAGE only, never CREATE). Per-table DML grants emitted by each table's migration.
choros_app connection contract: rolbypassrls=false, rolsuper=false, not table owner; runtime app connects ONLY as choros_app; runner ONLY as choros_migrator.
RLS template per tenant table (T-0013 4.3): ENABLE+FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; single default-DENY permissive policy USING + WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid).
audit_event/audit_head triggers (T-0016 4.6) part of baseline: no-mutate (UPDATE/DELETE) on audit_event for all roles; head forward-only +1; head no-delete for all roles.
ACT_* readiness (FR-6): our tables namespaced in choros schema; choros_app USAGE on choros only; zero ACT_* tables created; Flowable/Liquibase/BPMN NOT run (E0.5/S-1).

CI: existing ci job unchanged (web built first, tsc+eslint+fitness+vitest); NEW db job pins postgres:16 service container, runs runner + idempotency re-run + >=2-tenant suite + live probes (ci/checks/db/*); static lints (pg-single-dep.sh, audit_append_only.sh, no-committed-secret.sh, workflow lint) join npm run fitness; vitest.config.js already excludes .claude/** and ../choros-wt/**.

Compat (FE-W23-0008): purely additive at source; NO edit to src/core/types.ts/jobStore.ts/grant-lattice.ts/object-handle.ts public symbols; TS store rewrite consuming these tables is T-0114's zone; zero importers break.

fitness_functions.rule: Runner applies all migrations on empty DB (exit 0, every file recorded, all 8 tables exist) AND is idempotent (2nd run applies 0, schema_migrations unchanged, no DDL re-error).
fitness_functions.ci_check: live ci/checks/db/runner.test.ts: run runner -> exit 0, count(schema_migrations)=file count, each section-3.2 table in information_schema.tables schema choros; run again -> exit 0, count unchanged, schema_migrations diff empty. (AC-2/AC-3)

fitness_functions.rule: schema_migrations(version text PK, applied_at timestamptz); duplicate version -> PK violation.
fitness_functions.ci_check: live: information_schema.columns shape check; insert duplicate version -> 23505. (AC-4)

fitness_functions.rule: Every table in known_tenant_tables has ENABLE+FORCE RLS; no choros-schema base table missing from the fixture (anti-decorative).
fitness_functions.ci_check: live ci/checks/db/force_rls.sql: SELECT relname FROM pg_class JOIN pg_namespace WHERE nspname='choros' AND relkind='r' AND relname=ANY($known) AND NOT (relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity) MUST be empty. (AC-5; activates T-0013 FF-2, T-0016 FF-12)

fitness_functions.rule: Default-DENY: as choros_app with no SET LOCAL choros.tenant_id, count=0 on every tenant table.
fitness_functions.ci_check: live: migrator seeds tenant-A rows; choros_app (no GUC) SELECT count(*) on each tenant table = 0. (AC-6; activates T-0013 FF-3)

fitness_functions.rule: tenant_id is column 1 of every composite index and every FK on a tenant table.
fitness_functions.ci_check: live ci/checks/db/tenant_id_leading.sql: for each multi-col pg_index and each pg_constraint contype='f' on a $known table, column at position 1 = tenant_id; any violation fails. (AC-7; activates T-0013 FF-5)

fitness_functions.rule: Scoped uniqueness (same business key OK across tenants, dup within one -> unique violation); tenant_id NOT NULL enforced.
fitness_functions.ci_check: live: insert (A,slug=X) ok, (B,slug=X) ok, (A,slug=X) again -> 23505; insert tenant_id=NULL as migrator -> 23502. (AC-8/AC-9)

fitness_functions.rule: choros_app rolbypassrls=f, rolsuper=f, owns no tenant table; choros_migrator owns every tenant table + holds DDL; choros_app CREATE TABLE fails.
fitness_functions.ci_check: live: pg_roles for choros_app=(f,f); pg_class.relowner of every $known table = choros_migrator oid (and != choros_app oid); CREATE TABLE as choros_app -> 42501. (AC-10/AC-11)

fitness_functions.rule: choros_app UPDATE/DELETE on audit_event fails (SELECT/INSERT only); the no-mutate + head triggers exist.

fitness_functions.rule: Migrations idempotent AND consistent with >=2 tenants; scoped uniqueness never degenerates to global; no cross-tenant merge (tenancy section-9 guard 5, blocking).

runtime_target: Postgres in the silo docker-compose stack (one tenant per instance) - the dev substrate locally and the basis of every silo deploy. App connects as NOBYPASSRLS/non-owner choros_app; migrations run as choros_migrator. CI db job runs an ephemeral postgres:16 service container. FOUNDER GATE (GT-4) NOT triggered here: server provisioning / prod deploy (/srv/choros, Tailscale, prod creds) is E0.7, founder-gated; T-0053 commits NO prod secret and provisions NO server. Standing up Flowable (ACT_* engine) is E0.5, founder-gated (S-1) - T-0053 leaves room only.
